Name: Elemental Horses
Author: Zedxrgal0669
Description:
[b]Beautiful horses based off of the metal nodes of Stardew Valley.

[i]Currently Available (No Saddle):
[/i][/b]Default - Vanilla saddled
Copper
Iron
Gold
Iridium
Mystic
Radioactive

[b]Planned [i](possibly)[/i]:
[/b]Gemstones - Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/103065523]pirateSparkles[/url] for planting the idea seed for these.

[b]If I feel daring:
[/b]Prismatic

[b]These horse more than likely will never be saddled. 

Requirements:
[/b]Latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher & Generic Mod Config Menu

[b]Compatible with the Horse Overhaul & Tractor mods in testing. No issues so far. 
[/b]Not compatible with other horse skin mods.

[b]Huge thanks to!
[/b]The SDV Discord modding community. This is my first mod and they've been a big help in sussing out some hiccups and helping me fix them.

[b][i]Disclaimer: [/i][/b]Please do not use this mod in part or whole [i]without [/i]my permission to create your own mod. I've many days & unknown hours creating the assets and writing the code for this mod. I would really like it to not be taken & used by someone else.
